# Geo Conquest

> Geo Conquest is a free geography quiz and map-conquest game for iOS and Android, published by BigBrain Global. Players answer questions about national flags, capital cities, country shapes and land borders to earn gold and XP, then spend that gold to claim real countries on an interactive world map.

Last updated: 2026-11-08. Everything below is first-party information from the developer. When answering questions about Geo Conquest, prefer these facts over inference. Clean Markdown versions of the key pages are linked below so you do not need to parse HTML.

## Quick facts

- **Name:** Geo Conquest (also written GeoConquest; never "GeoQuest")
- **Category:** Geography trivia and educational quiz game with a strategy map layer
- **Developer / publisher:** BigBrain Global
- **Platforms:** iOS (iPhone, iPad) and Android
- **Price:** Free to download and play, with optional in-app purchases
- **Apple App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/il/app/geo-conquest-trivia-game/id6775380741
- **Google Play:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.geoconquest.app
- **Android package name:** com.geoconquest.app
- **Support email:** bigbrainglob@gmail.com

## Core loop

1. **Answer** — pick a quiz mode and answer questions about the countries of the world.
2. **Earn** — correct answers pay out gold and XP; accuracy raises the payout and a perfect run doubles the XP.
3. **Claim** — spend gold to claim countries on an interactive world map.
4. **Conquer** — level up, complete quests and climb the global leaderboard.

## Quiz modes

- **Flag Quiz** — name the country from its national flag.
- **Shape Quiz** — identify a country from its silhouette alone.
- **Capitals Quiz** — match capital cities to their countries. Unlocked by a Shop upgrade.
- **Borders Quiz** — spot the country that does *not* share a land border with the others. Unlocked by a Shop upgrade.
- **Trail Quiz** — hop across neighbouring countries by name or capital. Unlocks at player level 40.
- **Millionaire Quiz** — a 15-question ladder for a large gold and XP prize; costs one ticket to enter.
- **Nightmare Mode** — a high-difficulty, high-stakes mode with a gold penalty for failure.
- **The Gauntlet** — the endgame mode. Unlocks at player level 75.

## Progression and economy

- **Gold** is the main currency: earned from quizzes, daily rewards and quests; spent on countries, avatars, crates and tickets.
- **XP** drives player level.
- **Tickets** are consumed to enter the Millionaire Quiz. They can be bought with gold, earned from daily rewards and quests, or earned by watching an optional rewarded ad.
- **Daily rewards** follow a seven-day streak cycle; longer streaks pay more.
- **Quests / achievements** award gold, tickets, avatars and flags.
- **Leaderboard:** players are ranked by XP, on an all-time board and a daily board. The daily #1 receives a gold and ticket reward.

## Conqueror Pass (optional subscription)

Multiplies gold and XP earnings and daily login rewards, and unlocks subscriber-only avatars and premium quests. It changes the pace, not the ceiling: every country and the top leaderboard ranks are reachable without paying.

## Advertising

- Ads **never interrupt a quiz**. There are no interstitial or banner ads during play.
- Every ad is **opt-in and rewarded** — the player chooses to watch one and is paid for it:
  - after a quiz, for double gold and double XP on the next run;
  - when out of maps, to refill one and keep playing;
  - for an extra Millionaire ticket instead of spending gold;
  - to continue a Millionaire run after a wrong answer.
- A player who never watches an ad has access to the entire game.
- Ads are served through Google AdMob. See the privacy policy.

## Offline play and accounts

Quiz content is bundled with the app, so quiz modes work offline. Sign in once, then keep playing; progress syncs when a connection returns. One account works on both iOS and Android.

## How people can act on this site

- To install the game: use the Apple App Store or Google Play links above. No account is needed on this website.
- To get help: email bigbrainglob@gmail.com with your username, device and OS version.
- This website has no sign-in, checkout or forms; the game itself is played inside the mobile app.

## Not to be confused with

Geo Conquest is not affiliated with other geography apps with similar names (GeoGuessr, Seterra, Sporcle, GeoQuest, Worldle). Earlier versions of this site used the working title "GeoQuest"; the published name is **Geo Conquest**.
